facts.fact: Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan opened a joint account at Standard Chartered Bank Uganda to fund a feasibility study of a government-owned regional communications satellite, with a 30 September 2026 deadline for contributions; the roadmap and budget for the study were approved, no build agreement is stated, and the account date is given only as the report date.
